name: MonarchRoadmap
title: Roadmap
wrapsNative: com.rookhq.monarch.components.workflow.gantttimeline.MonarchGanttTimeline (with undated rows, quarter zoom and the roadmap's names), which is built on androidx.compose.ui.layout.SubcomposeLayout and Layout in androidx.compose.foundation.horizontalScroll, androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu, SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow and DateRangePicker in DatePickerDialog
summary: Projects over months and quarters, grouped by initiative, with progress, the health last reported in words, milestones and dependencies between projects, on the Gantt timeline.
whenToUse: To give leads a long-range view of projects across teams: when each runs, how far along it is, what was last reported and which projects block others. Pass onChange only where people really replan on this screen.
whenNotToUse: To schedule individual tasks by dragging use MonarchGanttTimeline directly. For a status-only overview without dates use a list of rows with MonarchStatusBadge or a board.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchRoadmap(items: List<MonarchRoadmapItem>, previousIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, nextIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, state: MonarchGanttTimelineState = rememberMonarchGanttTimelineState(initialZoom = MonarchGanttTimelineZoom.Year), groups: List<MonarchRoadmapGroup> = emptyList(), dependencies: List<MonarchGanttTimelineDependency> = emptyList(), milestones: List<MonarchGanttTimelineMilestone> = emptyList(), zoomLevels: List<MonarchGanttTimelineZoom> = listOf(MonarchGanttTimelineZoom.Month, MonarchGanttTimelineZoom.Quarter, MonarchGanttTimelineZoom.Year), today: Long? = System.currentTimeMillis(), timeZone: String? = null, toolbar: Boolean = true, onChange: ((MonarchRoadmapItem, MonarchGanttTimelineDates) -> Unit)? = null, onOpen: ((MonarchRoadmapItem) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchRoadmapLabels = MonarchRoadmapLabels(), timelineLabels: MonarchGanttTimelineLabels = MonarchGanttTimelineLabels(), toolbarActions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchRoadmapItem(id: String, label: String, start: Long? = null, end: Long? = null, groupId: String? = null, progress: Float? = null, progressText: String? = null, health: MonarchRoadmapHealth? = null, tone: MonarchTone? = null)
class MonarchRoadmapGroup(id: String, label: String, start: Long? = null, end: Long? = null, health: MonarchRoadmapHealth? = null)
enum class MonarchRoadmapHealth { OnTrack, AtRisk, OffTrack, NotReported }
class MonarchRoadmapLabels(health: ((MonarchRoadmapHealth) -> String)? = null, count: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, meta: ((first: String, second: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: items
options.description: The projects: id, label, start and target day keys (neither makes a row that says "No dates"), groupId, progress from 0 to 1, progressText such as "8/20", health (null writes none, NotReported writes "No health reported") and tone (null takes it from health).

options.name: previousIcon
options.description: The backward chevron of the toolbar. Monarch bundles no icons; the button is named "Earlier" without it.

options.name: nextIcon
options.description: The forward chevron of the toolbar, named "Later".

options.name: state
options.description: The first visible day, the zoom, chart or list. The roadmap opens at the quarter zoom (nine months visible).

options.name: groups
options.description: Initiatives, themes or teams as heading rows, in order. Each heading says how many projects it has and its health; a group with dates shows a thin span. Projects without a known group follow the groups.

options.name: dependencies
options.description: Links between projects, drawn as arrows and written as "Depends on" in the list.

options.name: milestones
options.description: Dated checkpoints: on a project's row with itemId, otherwise in a lane under the header.

options.name: zoomLevels
options.description: The zoom levels offered in the toolbar's zoom menu.

options.name: today
options.description: Any time on the day of the today line, read in timeZone; null hides the line and the Today button. Pass a fixed value in tests and previews.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The zone today is read in. An IANA id such as Europe/Berlin; null, or an id the device does not know, is the device's zone.

options.name: toolbar
options.description: Shows the toolbar: Earlier, Today, Later, the visible range, the zoom menu and the chart or list switch.

options.name: onChange
options.description: Makes dates editable (touch and hold then drag, keyboard, TalkBack actions, the date range picker in the list) and is called with the roadmap project and its new dates. Without it the roadmap is read-only.

options.name: onOpen
options.description: Makes each bar and list row a button that calls back with the roadmap project.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the roadmap's own strings: the health words, the group count and the joiner of a heading's second line.

options.name: timelineLabels
options.description: Replacements for the timeline's strings. The chart is named "Roadmap" and the row header says "Project" unless timeline or rowHeader is given here; every other value is passed through.

options.name: toolbarActions
options.description: Extra controls at the end of the toolbar, such as a team filter.

states.name: read only
states.description: The default. Bars have no drag, no key handling and no TalkBack actions; with onOpen they are still buttons that open the project.

states.name: editable
states.description: With onChange, everything the timeline offers to change dates, and onChange receives the roadmap project, not a timeline item.

states.name: health
states.description: On track, at risk, off track or no health reported is written in words on the row heading's second line, after the progress text; at risk tints the bar warning and off track danger.

states.name: no health tracked
states.description: With health null nothing is written about health and the bar keeps the accent color.

states.name: no dates
states.description: A project without dates stays in its group as a row that says "No dates" instead of moving to a separate list.

states.name: out of view
states.description: A project outside the visible window says "Ended …" or "Starts …" on its row.

states.name: list
states.description: The list view writes each project's dates, length, progress, progress text and health and its dependencies.

appearance: As MonarchGanttTimeline: on the surface color with subtle lines, group headings on the subtle background. Bars are a light tint of the accent with the accent's strong fill as outline and progress strip; at-risk bars use the warning tint and off-track bars the danger tint. The second line of each heading (progress text, health, count) is in the muted text color. High-contrast themes swap in their own roles.
platformNotes: There is no iOS Roadmap inventory entry yet, so the names follow the web and the plan (MonarchRoadmap, MonarchRoadmapItem, MonarchRoadmapGroup, MonarchRoadmapHealth, MonarchRoadmapLabels). The web shows health as a Badge with a dot next to the progress text; MonarchGanttTimeline takes its row meta as a plain String, so Android writes the progress text and the health word on one muted line ("8/20 · On track") with no dot or badge color: the words carry the meaning, the bar tint repeats it. The web's no-health dash with hidden text becomes the visible words "No health reported" (MonarchRoadmapHealth.NotReported), and the web's undefined versus null becomes null (nothing written) versus NotReported. Item title is a plain label, not a composable slot. Progress is 0 to 1 instead of 0 to 100, dates are UTC day keys instead of ISO strings, and onChange returns nothing (the web's promise and rollback become the app passing new items back). The web's tone accent is tone = null, because MonarchTone has no accent tone; an app cannot force the accent color on an at-risk or off-track project. defaultZoom becomes the state parameter, which defaults to the quarter zoom. Everything else (sideways-only chart scrolling, touch and hold to drag, the list as the phone and TalkBack alternative) is as described for gantt-timeline. Experimental because MonarchGanttTimeline is experimental and no Rook Android app has adopted it.
accessibility: Each bar is one element read as "<project>, <start> to <end>, <n>% complete"; with onOpen it is a button with a 48dp touch target reserved in the layout.
Health is written as words ("On track", "At risk", "Off track", "No health reported") in the row heading, never shown by the bar color alone.
A group heading is one TalkBack heading that reads its name, its project count and its health.
Without onChange bars have no TalkBack actions; with onChange they offer the timeline's move and resize actions and changes are announced by a polite live region.
The chart and the list are named "Roadmap" for TalkBack, and the row header says "Project", both replaceable.
Project names stay at the start in right to left layouts, and headings wrap at font scale 2.0 without cutting text.
edgeCases: A project without dates stays in its group as a "No dates" row; a project with only one date is a one-day marker.
A group with no projects says "0 projects"; a groupId that matches no group puts the project after the groups.
Without progressText and health a project heading has no second line.
An explicit tone always wins over the health tint.
Callbacks receive the same MonarchRoadmapItem instance the app passed, so the app can match it by identity or id.
Item lists are mapped again only when items, groups, labels or the configuration change.

examples.title: Projects by initiative
examples.template:
CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
    MonarchRoadmap(
        items = listOf(
            MonarchRoadmapItem(
                {{items.0.id}},
                {{items.0.label}},
                start = {{items.0.start|millis}},
                end = {{items.0.end|millis}},
                groupId = {{items.0.groupId}},
                progress = {{items.0.progress}}f / 100f,
                progressText = {{items.0.progressText}},
                health = MonarchRoadmapHealth.{{items.0.health|pascal}},
            ),
            MonarchRoadmapItem(
                {{items.1.id}},
                {{items.1.label}},
                start = {{items.1.start|millis}},
                end = {{items.1.end|millis}},
                groupId = {{items.1.groupId}},
                progress = {{items.1.progress}}f / 100f,
                progressText = {{items.1.progressText}},
                health = {{items.1.health}},
            ),
            MonarchRoadmapItem(
                {{items.2.id}},
                {{items.2.label}},
                start = {{items.2.start|millis}},
                end = {{items.2.end|millis}},
                groupId = {{items.2.groupId}},
                progress = {{items.2.progress}}f / 100f,
                progressText = {{items.2.progressText}},
                health = MonarchRoadmapHealth.{{items.2.health|pascal}},
            ),
            MonarchRoadmapItem(
                {{items.3.id}},
                {{items.3.label}},
                start = {{items.3.start|millis}},
                end = {{items.3.end|millis}},
                groupId = {{items.3.groupId}},
                progress = {{items.3.progress}}f / 100f,
                progressText = {{items.3.progressText}},
                health = MonarchRoadmapHealth.{{items.3.health|pascal}},
            ),
            MonarchRoadmapItem({{items.4.id}}, {{items.4.label}}, progressText = {{items.4.progressText}}),
        ),
        previousIcon = { Icon(SampleIcons.ChevronLeft, contentDescription = null) },
        nextIcon = { Icon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
        state = state,
        groups = listOf(
            MonarchRoadmapGroup({{groups.0.id}}, {{groups.0.label}}, start = {{groups.0.start|millis}}, end = {{groups.0.end|millis}}, health = MonarchRoadmapHealth.{{groups.0.health|pascal}}),
            MonarchRoadmapGroup({{groups.1.id}}, {{groups.1.label}}, start = {{groups.1.start|millis}}, end = {{groups.1.end|millis}}, health = MonarchRoadmapHealth.{{groups.1.health|pascal}}),
        ),
        dependencies = listOf(MonarchGanttTimelineDependency({{dependency.id}}, {{dependency.from}}, {{dependency.to}})),
        milestones = listOf(MonarchGanttTimelineMilestone({{milestone.id}}, {{milestone.label}}, {{milestone.date|millis}}, itemId = {{milestone.itemId}})),
        today = {{today|millis}},
        timeZone = "UTC",
        timelineLabels = MonarchGanttTimelineLabels(list = "Table"),
        onOpen = { /* The app opens the project here. */ },
    )
}

parityExceptions.convention: no marker, no placeholder dash on a phone row
